verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is an API-first server. It ships as a single binary with no external dependencies, installs with one cURL command, and has official Docker images and Helm charts, so it can run headlessly and be scripted through typed SDKs. A community member confirms a scripted Docker deployment that 'just worked' with 1M records. missing for 10: explicit CI/test-pipeline documentation (e.g. ephemeral instances in GitHub Actions), a published OpenAPI spec for automation tooling (the probe found none), and independent reports of CI usage specifically.
